# rg independent review

Verdict: **READY for parent exact-index verification and commit**. No production
logic/security blocker found within the selected contract. This is a proposed
checkout review, not proof of a staged or committed tree. STOP after eventual rg
commit; no next-command work.

## Reviewed scope and findings

Base HEAD: `1a18a53c7fcc4b2af83a989cb6c42326749375e4`; index remained empty.
Loaded command-development/review skills and project anatomy/API/coding/design/
TDD/verification procedures. Reviewed all 14 original allowlisted paths, module,
CLI/module tests, main registry/build/shell integration, contract and raw worker
ledger. Working code hashes match the worker manifest and fresh snapshots.

- Regex: C-thread-locale ERE, leftmost-longest, REG_NOTBOL on resumed suffixes;
  anchors remain line-local. Accepted empty candidates advance one byte, including
  EOL once. Word rejection retries start+1; no alternate-end backtracking at the
  same start (deliberate, documented difference). ASCII case/word boundaries and
  UTF-8 byte coordinates are consistent; empty JSON positions may split a codepoint.
- JSON: exact file/line/column/index/text keys, one record per nonoverlapping match,
  complete LF-stripped line, 1-based line/byte column and 0-based absolute byte index.
  Whole-file UTF-8 validation precedes output; NUL skip precedes encoding validation.
- Recursion: operand order/duplicates retained; bytewise sorted depth-first entries,
  hidden included; discovered final links/specials skipped, explicit ones rejected
  including slash-suffixed links. Whole NUL files skipped; context union/adjacent
  merge/group separators correct. Depth/file caps are documented, not ripgrep parity.
- Errors/resources: input errors continue, output errors stop, any failure wins
  status 2; parse/compile precede input. Owned descriptors/buffers/names are released,
  read-only opens, no intentional input mutation, exported getopt/argv/thread locale
  preserved. No private getopt-state, concurrency, sandbox, snapshot or fatal
  dependency-OOM recovery promise. SIGPIPE disposition is inherited.
- Integration: real main discovery/help/parity/loop/status and registry capacity
  covered, twelve builtins and eleven wrappers. Shared-file diffs are rg-only.
  README corrects stale standalone count as part of actual inventory maintenance.
- Delivery/security: only HEAD-derived README/FILES proposals, not mixed working
  documents. All local Markdown links in proposed allowlisted documents resolve in
  HEAD-plus-proposal checkout (including historical report/demo links). No signature
  match for private keys/credential literals; inspection found no private source
  content, shell execution, networking or unrelated hunks in proposed additions.
  Scratch fixture paths and compiler diagnostics are operational evidence, not secrets.
